bagPolicy.summary: For safety and security, only small clutches, belt bags, fanny-packs, or clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed. Bags larger than 6” x 9” must be clear and single compartment.
allowed: clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking onsite and in the surrounding area is extremely limited. Fans are encouraged to use satellite parking lots at nearby TTC subway stations or York University for convenient access to the venue.

rideshare.note: The entrances to our rideshare and pick-up/drop-offs are located at: When you reach this address, turn right into the pathway at the South Rideshare Pick-Up/Drop-Off sign and continue to the parking lot.

concessions.note: Rogers Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including alcohol at many concession stands and bars. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are available, with guidance provided by signage or team members.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The fan plaza and accessible seating sections at Rogers Stadium are all at ground level and are fully accessible via wheelchairs and/or mobility devices. All entrance gates, accessible seating sections, bathrooms, and the fan plaza, are ground level and accessible via wheelchair and/or mobility device.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Rogers Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Rogers Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Rogers Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
